name: cortico-world-overfield
description: Coopanion World for 开放空间 (OverField): capture/relay chat transport, event pushes (chat, scene, position, friends, profile), and chat replies. Chat recording lives in the separate 开放空间聊天 World. 开放空间扩展：抓包/中转读聊天、推送游戏事件、回消息；不截图、不 OCR、不注入游戏进程。
author: Mr-Tofu

zh.description: 《开放空间 / OverField》的事件与聊天扩展：被动抓包（只读）或本地中转（可读、可发附近/世界/私聊）。把私聊、提到你、关键词、场景、位置、好友上下线、本人资料变化推给桌宠，并可用 of_chat_send 回消息。聊天记录由「开放空间聊天」World 负责。不截图、不做 OCR、不注入游戏进程。非官方项目，仅供学习；中转会改动网络链路，存在账号风险，使用前请读免责声明。

en.description: Events and chat for 开放空间 / OverField: passive capture (read-only) or a local relay (read plus Nearby/World/Private sends). Pushes private messages, mentions, keywords, scene, position, friend online state and your profile changes, and can reply with of_chat_send. Chat recording belongs to the separate OverField Chat World. No screenshots, no OCR, no process injection. Unofficial, for learning; relay touches the network path and carries account risk — read the disclaimer first.
